name: Wiringproducts, Ltd.
old_description: Wiring Products was founded in 2004 with the goal of providing excellent quality 12 volt and automotive electrical parts supplies at competitive prices, with many of our products manufactured right here in the USA.
about:
Wiring Products was founded in 2004 in Sparks, Nevada, as a family-owned business focused on supplying 12-volt and automotive electrical parts. The company began with the goal of offering quality components at competitive prices, with an emphasis on domestic manufacturing.

The company produces a broad line of automotive electrical supplies, including automotive wire, battery cable, circuit breakers, copper lugs and eyelets, fuse holders and fuses, heat shrink tubing, molded trailer connectors, flashers and solenoids, and wire terminals. Many of these products are manufactured at its U.S. facility, though the company does not disclose facility size, headcount, or production volumes.

Wiring Products serves the automotive, marine, solar, RV and trailer, commercial, and industrial sectors. Its customer base includes both retail and wholesale buyers seeking electrical components for vehicle and equipment wiring, though specific client names are not public.

The business distinguishes itself through its commitment to U.S.-based manufacturing for a significant portion of its catalog, combined with a focus on product quality and competitive pricing. The family-run operation also highlights knowledgeable customer service as a core value.
